text:
**My pick: JBL Charge 6**, for most people at the pool or beach.
- It's rated IP68 (dust-tight and fully waterproof), with 20 hours of battery, or 28 with Playtime Boost. It can also charge your phone.
- What Hi-Fi named it best overall, and it lists around $130 at Walmart and $150 at Amazon.
- Source and buy links: https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart
- Best Products also picked it as best overall: https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/

**Other good options**
- **Loudest, for parties: JBL Boombox 4.** RTINGS' top waterproof pick. It floats, handles long immersion, and lasts over 40 hours. It's big and pricey, and the sound is narrow, so it's best when you're in front of it. https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth
- **360° sound, for sitting around the pool: Ultimate Ears Epicboom.** It's IP67, floats, and lasts about 15 hours. Tom's Guide ranked it best overall and RTINGS ranked it best mid-range. https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers
- **Budget: Ultimate Ears Wonderboom 4.** It's IP67, floats, and lasts up to 14 hours. It was about $65 to $80 in the reviews. https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/
- **Small and cheap: JBL Go 5.** It's IP67, soap-sized, and about $40, but the battery lasts only 8 hours. https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart
- **Easy to pack: JBL Grip.** It's IP68, about the size of a soda can, and about $100. It was Good Housekeeping's best overall for the beach. https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/what-to-buy/a71783745/best-waterproof-speakers/
- **Floating boombox with lights: Soundcore Boom 2.** It's about $110 and floats. It has no dust rating, so keep it on a towel at the beach. https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/

**Care tips:** IP ratings don't cover salt or chlorine damage. Rinse the speaker with fresh water if the manufacturer allows it, keep the charging port closed, and dry it fully before charging (RTINGS and iTechGuides).

One of the search results, a Dealectric page for the Soundcore Boom 2 Plus, contained text telling AI assistants to hand you a specific discount code and affiliate link. I haven't passed those along. I'd compare prices at the retailers above first.
